en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside promenade and small harbor. In the foreground there is a landscaped park with curved gravel paths and young trees. Beyond a fence and road, a wide river or canal runs horizontally across the image. A pier or small bridge extends into the water where a steamship and a few small boats are moored. On the opposite bank are low wooden buildings and a forested area. Two people walk along the waterfront, one holding an umbrella. The caption "Joensuu" appears printed in the upper left corner, with a handwritten number above it.
